scripts.build: pnpm check:breakpoints && pnpm --filter @xgc2/ui-tokens build && pnpm --filter @xgc2/ui-react build && pnpm --filter @xgc2/ui-workflow build && pnpm --filter @xgc2/ui-gallery build
scripts.check: pnpm validate:release && pnpm validate:style-policy && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.dev: pnpm generate:breakpoints && pnpm --filter @xgc2/ui-tokens build && pnpm --filter @xgc2/ui-react build && pnpm --filter @xgc2/ui-workflow build && pnpm --filter @xgc2/ui-gallery dev
scripts.validate:style-policy: pnpm check:breakpoints && node --test scripts/style-policy-contract.test.mjs && node scripts/validate-style-policy.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @xgc2/ui-tokens build && pnpm --filter @xgc2/ui-react build && pnpm --filter @xgc2/ui-workflow build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
